description: Generated zebra puzzle (5 houses × 3 attributes, 10 clues, unique solution verified by brute force).

input.message:
5 houses stand in a row, numbered 1 to 5 from left to right.
Each house has a different colour (red, green, blue, amber, violet), one resident (Ada, Bruno, Chen, Dara, Eli), and each resident drinks a different beverage (tea, coffee, milk, juice, water).

Clues:
1. the green house belongs to the water drinker.
2. the amber house is in house 2.
3. Eli lives in NOT the red house.
4. the water drinker is in house 3.
5. the milk drinker is directly next to the red house.
6. the water drinker is somewhere to the right of the juice drinker.
7. the coffee drinker is somewhere to the right of Dara.
8. Dara is in house 4.
9. the violet house is home to Chen.
10. the tea drinker is drunk by Bruno.

This puzzle has exactly one solution. Work out who lives in each house, its colour, and their drink.

End your answer with one line per house in EXACTLY this format:
House 1: <name> - <colour> - <drink>
House 2: <name> - <colour> - <drink>
(and so on)
